name: Glamping at the Paddocks
accommodation: Three 5m bell tents, each with own toilet, shower and cooking area
suitableFor: Couples and families wanting simple glamping
parking: Parking on the lane by the site (Visit Pembrokeshire)
dogs: Dog friendly, with a secure dog-walking field
beachAccess: About 1 mile from Manorbier beach (Visit Pembrokeshire)
confirmedFeatures: Private toilet and hot shower per tent, cook shack, BBQ, fire pit, bed linen, secure dog-walking area
overview: Glamping at the Paddocks has three bell tents on Shipping Hill Farm near Manorbier, each with its own toilet, gas shower and cook shack. The beach is about a mile away and Tenby around five minutes by car. It opens May to September.
surfTripFit: Private facilities per tent and a short hop to the beach make it a relaxed summer surf base.
